Data: [Palmer Penguins](https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/),
Palmer Station Antarctica LTER.

In this post I compare the body mass of three penguin species using pandas.

```{python}
import pandas as pd
from palmerpenguins import load_penguins
```

First, I load the data and remove rows with missing values.

```{python}
#| label: tbl-data
#| tbl-cap: "The load_penguins dataset"
penguins = load_penguins().dropna()
penguins.head()
```

Next, I compare the average body mass of each species.
This code groups the penguins by species, calculates the average body mass for each one, rounds it to one decimal place, and sorts them from heaviest to lightest. reset_index() turns species back into a regular column so the result displays as a proper table, and the last line shows that table on the page.

```{python}
#| label: tbl-mass
#| tbl-cap: "Average body mass (g) by species."
avg_mass = penguins.groupby("species")["body_mass_g"].mean().round(1).sort_values(ascending=False)
avg_mass = avg_mass.reset_index()
avg_mass
```

Finally, I count how many penguins of each species live on each island.

```{python}
#| label: tbl-count
#| tbl-cap: "Count of penguins in each islands"
pd.crosstab(penguins["species"], penguins["island"])
```

Gentoo penguins are the heaviest on average, and they only appear
on Biscoe island.
